method.merged_prs: merged pull requests across the three product repositories, by merge week, Toronto time
method.median_open_to_merge_hours: median hours from pull request opened to merged across the product repositories
method.tasks_estimated_and_closed: tasks with a posted estimate and a posted actual on the delivery ledger
method.on_time_pct: share of those tasks whose actual minutes were at or under the estimate
method.median_actual_over_estimate: median of actual / estimated minutes (below 1.0 = faster than estimated)
method.independent_reviews: distinct independent review verdicts, one per pull request revision and verdict (PASS or HOLD)
method.review_pass_pct: share of those verdicts that were PASS; each HOLD means the reviewer stopped a revision until an issue was fixed before shipping
method.passing_fault_injection_runs: local fault-injection test runs that passed: code was deliberately broken in each registered way and the test suite caught every one (tracked from November 2026)
